subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new persisted announceLastRun restart marker and tool-free subagent announce handoff boundary as the permanent behavior for interrupted announce delivery turns?
rationale: The code appears correct, but the PR deliberately changes session recovery semantics and tool availability across provider runtimes, which is a maintainer-owned product and security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept and land after lint
options.body: Accept the new session-state/tool-boundary behavior and merge once hosted lint is rerun or explicitly cleared.

options.title: Hold for broader upgrade proof
options.body: Request additional upgrade or provider-runtime proof before accepting the new persisted recovery marker and tool gating behavior.

options.title: Pause for alternative design
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want announce delivery represented without a new SessionEntry marker or with a different recovery state.

recommendation.title: Accept and land after lint
recommendation.body: Accept the new session-state/tool-boundary behavior and merge once hosted lint is rerun or explicitly cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant has the strongest combined history on subagent announce delivery and main session restart recovery, which are the central decision surfaces.
